newsitem.title: UK: Nat Grid, generators up on budget relief.
newsitem.headline: Nat Grid, generators up on budget relief.

text.p: Shares in National Grid Group Plc gained on Thursday as the company avoided being hit by the one-off windfall tax imposed by the Chancellor on other utility companies in the budget yesterday, dealers said.
National Grid shares climbed 11p to 244-1/26p by 0810 GMT.

Shares in Powergen Plc rose 23p to 752-1/2p and National Power Plc advanced 27p to 561p, as they were seen escaping the worst possible effects of the tax, which is expected to net the government around 5.2 billion stg over the next two years.

Shares in British Energy Plc nudged up 2-1/2p to 151-1/2p as analysts said the nuclear power generator would be unlikely to receive a significant windfall tax bill as its profits were much lower than other utility companies.
British Energy made a pre-tax profit for the year ended March 31 of 61 million stg while National Grid made 591.4 million stg for the same period.
